royal-exhibition.name: Royal Exhibition Building
royal-exhibition.price_text: Exterior free · interior tours around AUD 10–15, check on the day
royal-exhibition.hours: Garden open daily · interior only on guided tours, check on the day
royal-exhibition.tip: Australia's first UNESCO World Heritage building. Visit on a tour to see the painted dome inside.
royal-exhibition.best: Morning; spring for the Carlton Gardens

flinders.name: Flinders Street Station
flinders.price_text: Free to look · train fares separate
flinders.tip: Meet under the main clock on the corner. Best photo is from the opposite corner at dusk.
flinders.best: Dusk, when the facade lights up

shrine.name: Shrine of Remembrance
shrine.price_text: Free · guided tours free, donations welcome
shrine.tip: Go up to the balcony for a free view straight down St Kilda Road to the city.
shrine.best: Late morning or just before closing

fed-square.name: Federation Square
fed-square.price_text: Free to enter · events and venues priced separately
fed-square.hours: Square always open · visitor centre daily about 09:00–17:00
fed-square.tip: Start here for the visitor centre and free events on the main screen.

ngv.name: National Gallery of Victoria
ngv.price_text: Free general entry · major ticketed shows cost extra
ngv.tip: The free permanent collection is huge. The stained-glass ceiling in the Great Hall is the quick highlight.
ngv.best: Any time; quieter on weekday mornings

mcg.name: Melbourne Cricket Ground
mcg.price_text: Tour around AUD 30–40, check on the day · match tickets vary
mcg.hours: Tours most days, times vary with events
mcg.tip: Book a tour online and check the fixture list first, as tours stop on match days.

eureka.name: Eureka Tower
eureka.price_text: Observation deck around AUD 25–35, check on the day
eureka.tip: Go up about 30 minutes before sunset to see the city in daylight and at night.

st-kilda-beach.name: St Kilda Beach
st-kilda-beach.hours: Always open · patrolled in summer, check signs
st-kilda-beach.tip: Walk to the end of St Kilda Pier at dusk to look for little penguins. Keep your distance and no flash.
st-kilda-beach.best: Late afternoon to sunset; summer for swimming

state-library.name: State Library Victoria
state-library.tip: The domed La Trobe Reading Room is the photo. Go up to the balcony for the view down.
state-library.best: Morning, before the reading room fills

sea-life.name: SEA LIFE Melbourne Aquarium
sea-life.price_text: Around AUD 40–50 adult, cheaper online, check on the day
sea-life.tip: Book online for a lower price and a timed slot. Good rainy-day option.

arts-centre.name: Arts Centre Melbourne
arts-centre.price_text: Free to visit the spire area · shows priced per event
arts-centre.hours: Box office and foyer daily · show times vary
arts-centre.tip: Check the program for free or cheap events. The Sunday market nearby is worth a look.

boost-juice.name: Boost Juice
boost-juice.hours: Most stores daily, about 09:00–18:00, mall hours vary
boost-juice.tip: Australian smoothie chain with many CBD stores. Handy quick snack, not a destination.

cub.name: Carlton & United Breweries
cub.price_text: Brewery tours around AUD 30–40, check on the day
cub.hours: Tour days and times vary, book ahead
cub.tip: Book a tour in advance and check the meeting point, as the site is not a walk-in attraction.

luna-park.name: Luna Park (Melbourne)
luna-park.price_text: Free entry · ride passes around AUD 40–60, check on the day
luna-park.hours: Weekends and school holidays mainly, roughly 11:00–18:00, check on the day
luna-park.tip: Entry is free, so walk in for the famous face gate even if you skip the rides.

showgrounds.name: Melbourne Showgrounds
showgrounds.price_text: Varies by event; the Royal Melbourne Show is ticketed
showgrounds.hours: Only open for scheduled events, check the calendar
showgrounds.tip: Check the event calendar before you go, as there is nothing to see on non-event days.

monash.name: Monash University
monash.tip: Main campus is far out in Clayton. Only worth it for a specific visit, not general sightseeing.

unimelb.name: University of Melbourne
unimelb.tip: Walk the old quadrangle and the laneways nearby. Pairs well with Carlton Gardens.

wonderland-junior.name: Wonderland Junior
wonderland-junior.tip: Small kids' ride area. Confirm it is operating before you travel there.

yarra-cruise.name: Yarra River Cruise
yarra-cruise.price_text: Short cruises around AUD 30–45, check on the day
yarra-cruise.tip: Sit on the open deck. A one-hour loop is enough to see the skyline from the water.

queen-vic.name: Queen Victoria Market
queen-vic.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per stall
queen-vic.hours: Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat roughly 06:00–15:00 · Sun 09:00–16:00 · closed Mon and Wed
queen-vic.tip: Come hungry in the morning. The hot doughnut van is a local tradition.

hosier-lane.name: Hosier Lane street art walk
hosier-lane.tip: The art changes constantly. Look up as well as straight ahead, and be quiet near homes.

lygon-st.name: Lygon Street walk
lygon-st.hours: Restaurants daily, mostly lunch and dinner
lygon-st.tip: Melbourne's Italian strip. Walk a block past the loudest touts for calmer, better-value places.

fitzroy-walk.name: Fitzroy neighbourhood walk
fitzroy-walk.price_text: Free to walk · cafes and shops priced separately
fitzroy-walk.tip: Brunswick Street is the main strip. Wander the side streets for bars and small galleries.

southbank-prom.name: Southbank Promenade
southbank-prom.tip: Walk it at night for the skyline reflections. Buskers and restaurants line the way.

st-kilda-pier.name: St Kilda Pier and foreshore walk
st-kilda-pier.tip: Walk the pier at dusk for the penguins, then follow the foreshore path north for sunset.
